name: Jefferson County, IL
findings: Jefferson County has 136 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
